story.tez_2_interplan.dlg.stage1_jane_he: Without the servant, Tezctlan will not be able to open the gate to Duggur. Evacuate from the station, and we may yet try again. I imagine Tezctlan has no shortage of psychopomps like this one.
story.tez_2_interplan.name: Interplanetary Love
story.tez_2_interplan.objective0: Escort the servant of Tezctlan to the Duggur gate location.
story.tez_2_interplan.objective1: Travel to Duggur for an audience with Fokerma.
story.tez_2_interplan.objective2: Fokerma is vanquished. Return to Magnum.
story.tez_2_interplan.stage1.name: ISS Platform
story.tez_2_interplan.stage2.name: Duggur
story.tez_3_mine.after: Excellent. Now we must deliver the <color=#FFFEC1>Skull of Destiny</color> to the preeminent human temple in the Solar System. I am confident that the <color=#FFFEC1>Church of Revelation</color> has enough moral flexibility to easily proclaim me a god—and you my prophet, my knight, or whatever else you choose to style yourself.
story.tez_3_mine.briefing: The sensors are going haywire. Oddibjord-3 is in the grip of a quasimorphic storm—Venus itself seems to be spitting quasimorphs onto the surface. The Feathered Masks are ready for you. It looks like they'll defend that skull at any cost. That relic is your objective. You don't have to kill every quasimorph. Find the elevator to the excavation level.
story.tez_3_mine.details:
Details: Tezctlan has seized all of Venus, but resistance to his rule still smolders. Oddibjord-3 Station has been captured by taltnoms from the Feathered Masks order. The true Lord of Gannix orders us to go there and take the Skull of Destiny from those who still try to resist. This is an ancient symbol of Tezctlan's authority. He needs it to create a human cult that will become the foundation of the future Emerald Empire.

Additional Info: If the Feathered Masks dared to mount such a raid into the heart of the Emerald Empire, it means the most elite and battle-hardened quasimorphs will be waiting for us. We need to send our most highly trained clone on this mission, one who knows how to deal with the best of the best.
story.tez_3_mine.dlg.space_greeting: Excellent, <color=#FFFEC1>warrior</color>. The <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Empire</color> will soon be completed. The arrogant Fokerma has already been defeated. The lords of the remaining bramfaturas tremble in fear before me. Now our gaze turns to humanity. To the source of gavvakh. Humans will erect the Church of Tezctlan, and ancient hymns will fill the ether. But for this, we need a Symbol. The <color=#FFFEC1>Skull of Destiny</color> was once created by humans as my throne while I was a guest on Earth. Now it has ended up at the <color=#FFFEC1>Oddibjord-3</color> Station on Venus. Now it is in the hands of... traitors. Wretches who have turned their backs on me. The taltnom order of the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Masks</color> has rebelled against the Emerald Empire. Deceitful and cowardly knights led by a traitor, they simply fear that power. Go. Recover the Skull. Let the world have a symbol to worship me.
story.tez_3_mine.dlg.stage2_greeting: You've made it through, that's excellent news. I had some concerns that there were too many of them. The elevator you need is right in front of you. It leads to the excavations started by the Fresco Corporation and continued by AnCom. The Skull of Destiny is somewhere down there. You'll need to evacuate with it.
story.tez_3_mine.dlg.stage2_item_lost: Remember that you must evacuate with the Skull. You can't leave it behind. We'll need it to complete Tezctlan's next task. Assuming we even want to complete it...
story.tez_3_mine.dlg.stage2_item_picked: Taltnoms of Gannix! Spirits of freedom! I summon you here in a last attempt to save the living world from eternal tyranny. Tezctlan has found servants among human mercenaries and extended a hand of deceit to them. If the Skull of Destiny falls into his clutches, he will gain access to an inexhaustible source of gavvakh. And then there will be no room left for growth and movement. There will only be the empire of Tezctlan. But I tell you, freedom is more precious than eternity! Come here, taltnoms, and stop the mercenary! Do not let him take the Skull!
story.tez_3_mine.name: What's Mine Is Mine
story.tez_3_mine.objective0: This is a search-and-retrieval mission for the Skull of Destiny. It's on the lowest level.
story.tez_3_mine.objective1: You have what Tezctlan needs. Return to Magnum.
story.tez_3_mine.stage1.name: Colony
story.tez_3_mine.stage2.name: Excavation Site
story.tez_4_emerald.after: My eternal temple is founded. The faith that will nourish you humans has been established today. Go and feast, and afterward, you shall nourish me.
story.tez_4_emerald.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Duggur</color> no longer stands in the way of my plans. As my power grows, I can reach the distant bramfaturas of the Solar System. To demonstrate the might of the <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Army</color>, I am sending taltnoms with you to help break the resistance of the <color=#FFFEC1>Church of Revelation</color>.
story.tez_4_emerald.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Deliver the Skull of Destiny to Patriarch John Paul VI.
story.tez_4_emerald.details:
Details: Tezctlan has seized the Skull of Destiny, an ancient symbol capable of transforming pure human faith into a useful tool for the Empire. The time has come to approach the Church of Revelation, the most influential spiritual institution of humanity in the NCE era. We are to reach Carcosa Station, enter the Church's temple, and force the Skull of Destiny into their hands. Once the artifact is in the hands of the supreme hierarch, the subjugation phase will begin. The old doctrine will be consumed by the new faith, and the Church of Tezctlan will become a reality.

Additional Info: The Church's leadership is not ready to bow before Tezctlan voluntarily. They will resist, but the Lord of Gannix says the transformation of faith will begin the moment the preacher looks into the eyes of the Skull of Destiny. We must be prepared for resistance, both physical and metaphysical—little is known about the inner workings of the Church of Revelation. The success of this mission will mark the first step toward the hymns of the Emerald Empire resounding through the ether of the entire Solar System.
story.tez_4_emerald.dlg.space_contact: The time has come to establish my church, which will guide the spiritual path of the subjects of the <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Empire</color>. Among humans, I have found the man I need. Travel to the majestic temple in the <color=#FFFEC1>Carcosa</color> colony on <color=#FFFEC1>Titan</color>. Find the preacher there, <color=#FFFEC1>John Paul VI</color>, and present him with the <color=#FFFEC1>Skull of Destiny</color>. His soul is vast enough to cast aside his delusions and embrace the new, true faith.
story.tez_4_emerald.dlg.stage1_Johan6_en: Warriors of the faith! Today our Church undergoes its final trial! Hordes of demons, led by Satanist clones, are attacking the Holy See! Rise to the defense of our eternal religion, holy paladins! I bless you for the battle! Anyone who falls today defending Carcosa will instantly enter Paradise. Do not let them break through into my chambers!
story.tez_4_emerald.dlg.stage2_Tezctlan_: The preacher must not perish. I need him as a living conduit of faith. Do not dare to kill him. I need his warm, quivering soul. When you find the patriarch, place the Skull of Destiny so that he can see the empty eye sockets of my ancient vessel. Afterward, step into the shadows and watch. He won't be able to resist the call.
story.tez_4_emerald.dlg.stage3_Johan6_en: The enemy is close! To arms, my loyal employees! Your objective is to protect me at all costs! Suicide is a terrible sin! I refuse to commit it, and therefore I risk falling into the enemy's hands alive. It is unknown what they might use my mind for. To battle, for the glory of the true God!
story.tez_4_emerald.dlg.stage3_Johan6_te: Your gold is dim, and it will not blind someone accustomed to the light of Revelation. Not by human desire, but by the will of the NCE do I guide the flock! Come, demon!
story.tez_4_emerald.dlg.stage3_Tezctlan_: I endow you with the power and the will to serve me, my faithful new priest. Let the <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Temple</color> become a bastion of faith in the new god. Tezctlan the Almighty shall lead the Empire, and you will show the souls of my subjects the new path.
story.tez_4_emerald.name: Emerald Temple
story.tez_4_emerald.objective0: You need to carry the Skull of Destiny to the chambers of the Church of Revelation's patriarch. Place the Skull of Destiny within the patriarch's line of sight and step aside.
story.tez_4_emerald.stage1.name: Temple Outskirts
story.tez_4_emerald.stage2.name: The Temple
story.tez_4_emerald.stage3.name: The Patriarch's Chambers
story.tez_5_stones.after:
Humans have revealed two truths about themselves to me. Some bow in an instant; others die without yielding a single step. And the former are wiser. Take John Paul VI or, for example, you. You won by ending up on the right side. We will use your cloning technology to place the old archpriest at the head of the Emerald Coven. Death is no excuse to refuse a place prepared in the Emerald Empire.

Well then, humanity is dealt with. Subjugating the rest is just a matter of time. You will be more than capable of handling it. The main battle lies ahead. On Mars, my old enemy awaits his hour.
story.tez_5_stones.briefing: Hyperion's terrain is brutal. We'll drop you into a canyon jagged with sharp rocks, close to the evac hatch from Pilgrim's Rift Station. The Sunlight Coven's main sanctum is on the Third Level. The Archpriestess should be there.
story.tez_5_stones.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Compel Edita Domina to kneel before Tezctlan.
story.tez_5_stones.details:
Details: Following the transformation of the Church of Revelation into the Emerald Temple, Tezctlan has ordered his rule to be extended to another influential spiritual corporation—the Sunlight Coven. They have always balanced between selling special pharmacology and speculating in spiritual services. We need to infiltrate Pilgrim's Rift Station and use threats to compel Edita Domina to perform a ritual of worship to Tezctlan.

Additional Info: We do not expect any problems. The Solar System is gradually bowing to the new reality. Tezctlan's green sun is rising over a new era.
story.tez_5_stones.dlg.greeting:
How dare you disobey, you hired scum!

Attention! Block the elevator to the Coven headquarters.
story.tez_5_stones.dlg.space_greeting: The <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Temple</color> rises among people, but the world is filled with weeds that still obscure the Empire's radiance. The <color=#FFFEC1>Sunlight Coven</color> still peddles revelation. They also have the power to expand the influence of the ancient hymns that nourished me for centuries on Earth. Travel to <color=#FFFEC1>Pilgrim's Rift</color> on <color=#FFFEC1>Hyperion</color> and compel Archpriestess Edita Domina to bow to my will. Let this cult, too, become part of the jungles of Gannix.
story.tez_5_stones.dlg.stage1_ceo_killed: You've done it. A waste of gavvakh. Then again, he was foolish enough to enter battle with my servant. Don't make the same mistake with the archpriestess! Make her bow before me. I need a servant like her alive. The Emerald Coven will ignite the hearts of all the believers whom the Emerald Temple cannot control. The way is clear, move on.
story.tez_5_stones.dlg.stage2_greeting: I will never bow to a monster. A person needs a person, not a demon or a clone.
story.tez_5_stones.dlg.stage3_edith_deat: She broadcast this message throughout the station. Everyone capable of holding a weapon is heading your way. They're out for revenge. Get out of there.
story.tez_5_stones.dlg.stage3_edith_enco: I spit on you and your false god, <color=#FFFEC1>mercenary</color>. You've turned Magnum into an instrument of absolute evil. And better a horrible end than endless horror. Your cowardly, petty soul cannot understand this. Is it easy to command genocide from the other side of the screen and drive hordes of clones to the slaughter? Farewell.
story.tez_5_stones.dlg.stage3_greeting: Be careful! She is going to resist. I detect a weapon in her hands.
story.tez_5_stones.name: Standing Stones
story.tez_5_stones.objective0: Reach Edita Domina and compel her to kneel before Tezctlan.
story.tez_5_stones.objective1: Fight your way to the elevator.
story.tez_5_stones.stage1.name: First Level
story.tez_5_stones.stage2.name: Second Level
story.tez_5_stones.stage3.name: Third Level
story.tez_6_erad.after:
Do not be troubled, priest. The image of Tezctlan still lingers in the world, and his Emerald Empire has been set free. I need his shell to remain warm for a little while longer. His networks, his emblems, his warriors—all of it now breathes with my will.

Tezctlan was only a vessel. The emerald glow of his Empire is a shell within which my form ripened. I will gradually fill it with myself, and then the Red and Gold Throne will once again shine over the Solar System.

Let people believe they are serving Tezctlan. Let them pray to his name. But their faith is already flowing to me.
story.tez_6_erad.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Shedu's Thousand</color> have concentrated their guard at the landing site. Break through to the lower level as quickly as you can. If the Itzpapalotl really can bring down <color=#FFFEC1>Urparp</color>, his troops will stop drawing power from the bramfatura and won't be able to mount serious resistance.
story.tez_6_erad.details:
Details: Ur the Awakened imperils the designs of the Emerald Empire. This ancient quasimorph was once defeated by the Lord of Gannix, but its essence has once again broken through the thin veil separating Pleroma from Kenoma. Tezctlan orders us to finish what was started and destroy Urparp forever. The only way is to use the Itzpapalotl, the weapon that already pierced the heart of this creature once before.

Additional Info: The battle with Urparp will be more than just a physical confrontation. The quasimorph embodies and anchors the very bramfatura of Mars. Expect aberrant mission conditions. Tezctlan insists that only a precise strike with the Spear will be able to slay Urparp and clear the way for the Emerald Empire's expansion.
story.tez_6_erad.dlg.space_contact:
Urparp... A persistent reminder of the past. He stirs again in the dust of Mars. Now he no longer seeks to build an Empire. He has become a zealous guardian of the Throne of Gagtungr.

I once plunged my Spear into his heart and thought the stone had swallowed him forever. But the Sinkhole Oasis has revived, and the conquering worm once again raises its head. Take the Itzpapalotl. Finish what was started. Let Urparp return to his stone slumber. This time, I have a present from AnCom. This time, there will be no awakening.
story.tez_6_erad.dlg.stage2_Urparp_entra: From my new legionnaires in red armor, I learned the meaning of madness. Are you here to repeat what <color=#FFFEC1>Tezctlan</color> failed to do the first time, and what you failed to do the second time?
story.tez_6_erad.dlg.stage2_Urparp_monol: We will fight on my terms.
story.tez_6_erad.dlg.stage3_Gangtungr_af:
Excellent, priest. I could not have dreamed of two victims so filled with gavvakh. How many years did they spend in the human world? All this time they accumulated power. Now it's all mine. Their rage, their ancient feud only accelerates the outflow of power.

I am satiated. I am ready to emerge and leave the Sun.

You are my guide, my first servant. Through you, Gagtungr came. Thanks to you, I will taste the world.
story.tez_6_erad.dlg.stage3_Gangtungr_ar:
Silence!

King of Gannix. Lugal of Ur. Raise your eyes and bow to the Red and Gold Throne. The cycle is close to completion. Tezctlan—the seed of life. Urparp—the seed of destruction. Each of you rose against me, and each guarded the Sun when it was silent. Now I will arise from your union. Kill this clone and destroy Magnum. From blood soaked with the scent of hope and mad courage, a new spark of my being will ignite.
story.tez_6_erad.dlg.stage3_Tezctlan_are: What about him? Will he appear himself? I always do, Urparp. The mortal merely fulfilled his destiny and delivered the spear. The humming anchor of my will, left in your heart, has again opened the path for me into your domain. We have met again. And the mortal... is merely the bearer of the key.
story.tez_6_erad.dlg.stage3_Urparp_arena: Ha-ha... A familiar thing. The Spear. And familiar pain. I felt this sting when the Sun had just fallen silent, and I took upon myself the burden of the guardian of the Solar Empire. For long millennia, its tip hummed in my body like the bell of a dead god. And now you bring it back—an obedient slave of Tezctlan, retracing the steps of others across the ashes of old wars. Do you really think he...
story.tez_6_erad.name: Eradication
story.tez_6_erad.objective0: Reach Urparp and slay him with the Itzpapalotl.
story.tez_6_erad.stage1.name: Trade Dock
story.tez_6_erad.stage2.name: The Zone
story.tez_6_erad.stage3.name: The Dream of a Monster
story.tez_side_1_poison.after:
The quasimorphs delivered the Skull to the spacecraft while the battle raged below. Did he believe in Ilhutl that little, or that much in us, Boss? The

Magnum and the crew are ready to fight wherever you send us. The Emerald Empire? Well, then. Let's go.
story.tez_side_1_poison.briefing: Killing a single quasimorph? Sounds easy. Good luck, though.
story.tez_side_1_poison.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Defeat <color=#FFFEC1>Ilhutl</color>, the Great Chosen Knight of Gannix, in combat.
story.tez_side_1_poison.details:
Details: Tezctlan has turned the Feathered Temple into a base for the Emerald Empire's guard. The poisonous knight Ilhutl awaits us there. Tezctlan is ready to make a special pact with a mortal who can defeat Ilhutl.

Additional Info: Tezctlan is trying to gain a foothold in two worlds at once. After visiting Earth, he felt cramped in the bramfatura of Venus, limited by the laws of the quasimorphic world. With the help of gavvakh, which his loyal servants obtain on the battlefields of the physical world, Tezctlan and his servants are creating a new Empire beyond the boundaries between realities.

We have attracted the attention of Tezctlan. He is ready to make a unique contract with us, according to which you, Boss, will become one of the hierarchs of the Emerald Empire.

However, the Master needs proof. And not of loyalty, but of strength. We must defeat Ilhutl, the Poison Knight, champion of the Gannix guard.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.ilhutl_after: It doesn't matter how many clones you send here. I will drink gavvakh from each one. The warriors of <color=#FFFEC1>Gannix</color> will witness our battle. You will not serve the <color=#FFFEC1>Master</color>!
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.ilhutl_rnd1: That is not dead which can eternal lie, fool.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.ilhutl_rnd2: Do you think Tezctlan sent you to prove your strength? You are merely a sacrifice for <color=#FFFEC1>me</color>.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.ilhutl_rnd3: People's dreams of power are such fertile soil for the seeds of suffering.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.ilhutl_rnd4: You cannot defeat me. Your world was ready for my coming. It accepted me as it once accepted my Master.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.ilhutl_rnd5: I hope, clone, your Boss <color=#FFFEC1>will send me another one</color>.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.jane_after_a: Sensors are registering a drop in quasimorphic energy. Now we can complete the mission. <color=#FFFEC1>Find and destroy Ilhutl</color>.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.jane_after_f:
I detected a huge energy surge. Analyzing...

There are five such monoliths in the Feathered Temple. Well, already four. It looks like they are what’s keeping Ilhutl in the physical world.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.space_after_: You awakened me, you believed in me. You gave me information about my enemies in the solid realm. You have earned my attention. But you are but a mortal, leading other mortals into battle. You must prove yourself worthy of taking a place in the ranks of the <color=#FFFEC1>Emerald Empire</color> army. The Great Chosen Poison Knight <color=#FFFEC1>Ilhutl</color>, one of my servants, is now on Venus. He will be waiting for you in the <color=#FFFEC1>Feathered Temple</color>. Defeat him, and I will make a pact with you. You will become one of the commanders of the Emerald Empire and gain power commensurate with my generosity.
story.tez_side_1_poison.dlg.tezctlan_aft:
You have proven that you have skill and dignity. I will decide the future of Ilhutl myself.

The Pact of Eternal Service to the Emerald Empire has already been sent to your spacecraft. Serve me faithfully, and your eyes will reflect a green glow. Disappoint me, and you will envy the dead.

I ordered you to defeat Ilhutl. Ilhutl is not defeated. Fight until you truly do it.

And to make it more interesting for me to watch, I allow my warriors to fight on Ilhutl's side.
story.tez_side_1_poison.name: Poison Trial
story.tez_side_1_poison.objective0: <color=#FFFEC1>Ilhutl</color> must be defeated. Tezctlan ordered it.
story.tez_side_1_poison.objective1: Ilhutl is defeated. This time for good.
story.tez_side_1_poison.stage1.name: Ancient Trial
story.tutorial_1_defense.after: It's over. The Magnum has sustained minor damage. Basically, it won't affect the functionality of the equipment and crew, so we can go where we want and do what we want.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal1: And here's our <color=#FFFEC1>arsenal</color>. Ammo and melee weapons have different <color=#FFFEC1>damage types</color>, and armor has different <color=#FFFEC1>resistance types</color>. To win, choose wisely with what and how you attack.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal2_co:
To reload your weapon, press {0}. If the ammo is in the tactical vest slot in the middle of the screen, press {1} to switch to the vest control mode and select the ammo slot. Press {2} and reloading will take fewer AP.

You have two weapon slots. You can quickly switch between them by pressing {3}.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal2_ke:
To reload your weapon, press {0}. If the ammo is in the tactical vest slot in the middle of the screen, press the corresponding quick-access slot key, and reloading will take fewer AP.

You have two weapon slots. You can quickly switch between them by pressing {1}.
story.tutorial_1_defense.dlg.arsenal2_mo:
To reload your weapon, press {0}. If the ammo is in the tactical vest slot in the middle of the screen, press the corresponding quick-access slot key, and reloading will take fewer AP.

You have two weapon slots. You can quickly switch between them by clicking on the image of the active weapon in the top left or by pressing {1}.
